label: Ruff
command: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff check app tests alembic; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff format --check app tests alembic

label: full local validation
command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $env:PATH = "$env:USERPROFILE\.cargo\bin;$env:PATH"; Set-Location apps\backend; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff check app tests alembic; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff format --check app tests alembic; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('alex-alembic-check-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString() + '.db'); $env:DATABASE_URL = 'sqlite:///' + ($tmp -replace '\\','/'); try { .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m alembic upgrade head; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m alembic check; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } } finally { Remove-Item Env:DATABASE_URL -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item $tmp, "$tmp-wal", "$tmp-shm" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip_audit; Set-Location ..\desktop; npm test; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm run format:check; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npx tsc -b --pretty false; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npx vite build; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm run test:e2e; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm audit --omit=dev; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Set-Location src-tauri; cargo check; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; cargo test; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Host 'LOCAL_VALIDATION_OK'
